title: vx lock --check --format json
description: The lock audit: exit 0 when upToDate, else 1 with each drift in problems.

audited.description: projects audited: each with a vx.config, and each with none that a plugin's project stage gives tasks

notAudited.description: always 0: every project with tasks is audited, a plugin-mapped one included

code.description: Stable; branch on it, as schemas/error.json's: VX_E_LOCK for drift `vx lock` fixes (a missing lock is one), VX_E_CONFIG for a config that does not load or holds a secret, VX_E_REFUSED for another refusal (a plugin hook that failed, two projects of one name), and a graph rule's own (VX_E_CYCLE, VX_E_DEPENDS_ON, VX_E_OUTPUT_OVERLAP, …)

message.description: the problem as the plain audit prints it on stderr; may change
